viewport: m, s, d (JS on and off)
defect: The sort <select> chevron points LEFT (a back-arrow affordance) instead of down. The ::after glyph is built from border-inline-end + border-block-end rotated 45deg; in RTL border-inline-end is the LEFT edge, so the left+bottom corner rotates to point left.
evidence: All twelve collection fold PNGs show the pill 'מומלץ'/'א–ב' with a '<' chevron at its inline-end (e.g. collection-all-m-js-fold.png at y=560, collection-path-d-js-fold.png at x=82,y=468). Geometry: bottom-left corner vector (-1,1) rotated 45deg clockwise = (-1.41,0) = left.
fix: Line 147: replace border-inline-end:1px solid ... with border-inline-start:1px solid var(--env2-ink-2) (keep border-block-end and rotate(45deg)); or use physical border-right/border-bottom. Result: the corner points down on both directions.

defect: The section-11 assertion 'pill change -> price updates AND the sticky form input[name=id] equals the chosen variant' has NO positive evidence in this run: idsAgree:true is vacuous because neither id ever left the initial variant. The mirror cannot exercise Kalles' picker (it awaits getJSONProduct.load(handle) over the network before selectVariant/variant:change), so the sticky-sync listener on line 27 was never observed firing. Not a proven theme defect, but an unproven buy-path assertion.
evidence: verify.json pdp-variant-sync: clicked:null, before.mainId=after.mainId=stickyId=48880936190126, price ''. hybrid-rerun.json: clicked '12 מ׳ / 100 נורות', checked changed, but mainId/stickyId unchanged, idChanged:false, priceChanged:false, unitChanged:false. Kalles 36fe7014...js: connectedCallback awaits getJSONProduct.load(this.getAttribute('handle'), variants-pages) then on_value_change_fn -> selectVariant -> masterInput.form.dispatchEvent(variant:change). The live proof cited (variant 2 renders 99.90 via ?variant=) is server-side rendering, not the JS sync.
fix: Run verify.js (live preview, not the mirror) at 390x844 on solar-rope-string-lights: click the '12 מ׳ / 100 נורות' label, wait for variant:change, assert main input[name=id] != 48880936190126, sticky input[name=id] == main, .hdt-money text changed to 99.90 and the unit caption to the 12 m value; then click the sticky button and assert the drawer line item id equals the chosen id. Record the result in verify.json before sign-off; only change line 27 if that run fails.

viewport: m, s, d (JS on and off)
defect: The 1-variant product renders a variant picker with a single pre-selected pill ('צבע אור: צהוב חם') and, with JS off, a one-option <select> ('צהוב חם – 169.90 ₪'): a choice control with nothing to choose, against P1 'stock pattern the shopper already knows'. Cause: the product carries a one-value option in Admin; the noscript select on line 112 iterates product.variants unguarded, so simply deleting the option would print 'Default Title – 169.90 ₪' in no-JS.
evidence: pdp-path-m-js-fold.png y=752..820: label 'צבע אור: צהוב חם' + one gold pill; pdp-path-m-nojs-fold.png y=756: select 'צהוב חם – 169.90 ₪'; pdp-path-d-js-fold.png x=581..668,y=343..388. verify.json pdp-path smallTaps:1 = that single sr-only radio. Mirror markup: <hdt-variant-picker ... data-size='1'> with one fieldset/one radio. grep has_only_default_variant templates/product.elmsnest.json = 0 hits.
fix: Two parts: (owner-admin) Products -> מנורת שביל סולארית מנירוסטה -> remove the option 'צבע אור' so the product becomes default-variant (Kalles then omits the picker); (theme) wrap the noscript block on line 112 in {% unless product.has_only_default_variant %}...{% endunless %} so no-JS never shows 'Default Title'.
